summary: Comprehensive backend regression tests (26 pytest cases) covering auth, CU/Puskopdit/Users CRUD, settings, PDF upload, permohonan+analisis+pencairan happy flow, iuran rapel, dashboard, and petugas role scoping. Also smoke-tested the React frontend (login, dashboard, Pengaturan, Data Induk, Permohonan form) via Playwright. All 26 backend tests pass against the preview URL. Frontend renders cleanly, money inputs auto-format with dots (e.g. 500.000.000), total auto-calculates, nav data-testids present, Pengaturan editable with brackets, kop upload, settings-save-btn. Admin login works, wrong password returns 401 and triggers 5x rate limit (429) per /app/auth_testing.md. Hash is bcrypt ($2b$), startup seed updates admin password if changed.

minor.issue: No DELETE endpoint - once a permohonan is cairkan'd it cannot be removed by DELETE /api/permohonan/{id} (400). Makes cleanup of accidental pencairan impossible via API; requires DB access. Consider adding an admin-only cancel/void endpoint.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True in server.py line 707 – Starlette will silently drop Access-Control-Allow-Credentials when origin is wildcard. Not a bug today (no cookies used; JWT in Authorization header) but misleading config.
write_settings casts all non-bracket keys to int unconditionally; a payload omitting any key is fine, but passing a non-numeric value yields 500 (ValueError) instead of 400. Low priority.

issues: Group label 'Data Induk' (p tag) duplicates text with the nav link below – harmless but caused Playwright strict-mode conflict. Consider using get_by_role('link'). Not a user-facing issue.

action_items: Consider adding a cancel/void pencairan endpoint (optional).
Tighten CORS_ORIGINS to explicit preview origin instead of '*' with credentials (optional).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 731 lines – approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting routers (auth/users/cu/permohonan/analisis/pencairan/iuran) into separate modules.
FastAPI startup/shutdown uses deprecated @app.on_event; migrate to lifespan context (non-blocking).
/api/settings write path: int() coercion can raise ValueError => 500. Wrap with try/except -> HTTPException(400).

analyze() in calc.py: when u_ang.desimal <= smallest bracket.sampai it works, but if a bracket list is empty cap stays 0 silently => sanduk disetujui = 0. Validate at settings PUT that brackets non-empty.
/api/pencairan returns raw doc that already excludes _id via doc.pop; fine. But sum() over missing keys would KeyError – protected by earlier validation (hasil check + total_disetujui).
login_attempts collection is never pruned; add TTL index on 'until' or cleanup on startup.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login, nav, forms, money format, pengaturan all OK)

seed_data_creation: All TEST_-prefixed data was created and cleaned up afterwards. Also wiped residual pencairan/files/temp_files and reset settings.nomor_berikutnya=1 so main agent gets a clean DB (0 CU, 0 permohonan, 1 admin user).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_tudung_api.py. Run with: cd /app && pytest backend/tests/test_tudung_api.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml  (Important: use -n 0 to override xdist=2 in pytest.ini – session fixtures create unique CU codes and would collide across workers.). The suite expects server date Asia/Jakarta = 2026-10-10. If 'today' moves, update TODAY constant. All data is TEST_-prefixed; teardown is best-effort (pencairan has no DELETE so leftover 1/T/PUSAKA/X/2026 may need Mongo cleanup).
